import html # Template for a blog post; placeholders are marked by {title} and {body} BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def render_blog_post(title: str, body: str) -> str: """ Render a blog post safely for display on a web page. Parameters ---------- title : str The user‑supplied title of the blog post. body : str The main content/body of the blog post. Returns ------- str A sanitized, HTML‑escaped string that can be safely inserted into the page. Raises ------ ValueError If either title or body is empty after stripping whitespace. """ if not title.strip(): raise ValueError("Title cannot be empty.") if not body.strip(): raise ValueError("Body cannot be empty.") # Escape special HTML characters to prevent injection (CWE‑74) safe_title = html.escape(title, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(body, quote=True) # Render the final HTML return BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body)
